body.statement: Using the legal blocker-packing handle, derive an explicit evaluable \(Q(n,K,d,\tau,s)\) and universal constants \(0<c_0\le C_0<\infty\) such that \(c_0Q(n,K,d,\tau,s)\le N^{\star}(n,K,d,\tau,s)\le C_0Q(n,K,d,\tau,s)\) for every feasible \(s\), with the lower inequality certified by legal full-oracle baseline alternatives and the upper inequality attained by an adaptive emergent-path parent-blocking policy.
body.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: it replaces a quadratic existence bound by a minimax resource law across every intervention budget.
body.gap: VariciKatzWeiSattigeriTajer2024Interventional explicitly leaves constrained-size count lower bounds open, and the single-DAG count papers rely on a known skeleton or essential graph.
body.consumer: The formula would determine the number of bounded multi-gene perturbation panels needed to recover a latent cell-state union network at the population-identification level.

obligation.what_is_open: An explicit evaluable all-parameter function \(Q(n,K,d,\tau,s)\) with matching universal-factor adaptive upper and legal full-oracle transcript lower bounds.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen primitives do not show that enough source-plus-last-parent blocker requirements coexist on one legal baseline transcript. Requirements obtained from different baselines cannot be combined in the transcript-packing lemma, while the cover upper bound need not be adaptively optimal.
obligation.attempted: The parent-blocking inclusion--exclusion cover gives a nonadaptive upper bound, and the transcript-packing lemma turns any one legal baseline family into a hitting-set lower bound. Dense chains and height-one unions make subsets of the requirements coexist, but neither construction realizes the general blocker cover under the simultaneous indegree and cyclic-complexity caps.
obligation.partial_result: The proved feasibility threshold is exact. Whenever \(s\ge r=\min\{d+1,n-1\}\), \(N^{\star}\le F(n,r,s)\le U_{\mathrm{PB}}(n,r,s)\); at the additional cycle-free feasible endpoint \(s=d\), a proved policy uses at most \(n+n(n-1)\) queries; and the dense endpoint has exact value \(n\).
